ar.label: Autoregressive
ar.summary: Left-to-right decoding. Each forward pass predicts one token; the sample is appended to the context and the pass repeats.

loop.label: Next token appended to context
loop.sublabel: one token per pass · causal mask

diffusion.label: Diffusion
diffusion.summary: Parallel decoding. Every position is denoised at once; the model is conditioned on the timestep and iterates from noise to text.

loop.label: T denoising iterations
loop.sublabel: all positions in parallel · no causal mask

scene1.line: The future of artificial intelligence does not belong to electricity alone.

scene2.description: Quantum states explore complex possibilities simultaneously, unlocking new paths for machine learning beyond classical computation.

scene3.description: Where light computes, machine learning accelerates.

scene4.description: Thermodynamic Natural optimization that harnesses thermal fluctuations to explore better solutions.

scene5.statement: QPT — the first language model to combine the best of three types of computing to achieve greater efficiency and lower cost.
scene5.detail: Each transformer component is assigned to the computing paradigm that best expresses its underlying mathematics — classical, quantum, photonic, or thermodynamic.

scene6.generatedText: Today you think this is bullshit; in 15 years you will realize that this idea will reach the world. This is the moment to prepare before the hardware boom explodes — by making artificial intelligence more efficient across combined forms of computing.

scene7.final: QPT exists to answer a research question: Which parts of a language model actually benefit from non-classical computing, and by how much?

scene8.suffix: will also play an important role in this process.

hero.uvp: While some bet on building the best single component for their computer, we bet on collaborative work — coming together to unite all these pieces and make the best possible computer.

market.title: At the intersection of every funding wave.
market.lead: QPT sits at the convergence of five of the strongest capital and grant currents in technology today. Each wave funds a piece of the stack; QPT is the only position that qualifies for all of them at once.

team.title: Built by people who span every paradigm.

ceo.desc: SInternational speaker with over 10 talks delivered across three languages, three-time winner of EAFIT’s Best Systems Engineering Project, and Claude Hackathon winner 2025.

ctoMulti.desc: Leader of the Quantum Computing Research Group at EAFIT, IEEE Student Chapter representative at EAFIT, and speaker on integrating quantum computing with AI.

ctoAi.desc: Featured speaker renowned for his talk on building a transformer from scratch (presented over three times) and leader of the AI Research Group Aperture at Universidad Nacional, Medellín.

p1.title: Semi-professional autoregressive & diffusion LM
p1.desc: Build our own baseline language models — both the autoregressive and the diffusion families — as the substrate every later phase trains against.

p2.title: Other-paradigm LMs by simulation, ×3
p2.desc: Simulate quantum, photonic, and thermodynamic compute and train paradigm-native LMs on each — before touching real hardware.

p3.title: Hybrid mixing — paradigm per layer
p3.desc: Mix quantum, photonic, and thermodynamic computation inside each layer of the model — the core QPT thesis in code.

p4.title: Improve autoregressive & diffusion performance
p4.desc: Feed everything learned back into the baseline models: faster, cheaper, better autoregressive and diffusion LMs.

p5.title: Produce our own hybrid algorithms
p5.desc: Stop borrowing and start inventing: proprietary hybrid algorithms that natively exploit mixed-paradigm hardware.

p6.title: Train with hybrid algorithms + simulation
p6.desc: First full training runs driven entirely by our own hybrid algorithms, validated in simulation at scale.

p7.title: Train on rented paradigm hardware
p7.desc: Move from simulation to real rented quantum, photonic, and thermodynamic hardware for live training runs.

p8.title: Buy our own paradigm hardware & train
p8.desc: Own the substrate: acquire quantum, photonic, and thermodynamic machines and train the models on our own fleet.

p9.title: Expand to new horizons
p9.desc: Push past the original three paradigms and keep producing our own hybrid algorithms for the substrates that follow.

p10.title: Own biological & ternary computers
p10.desc: Acquire a biological computer (natural neural networks) and Huawei's trits (ternary) computer — and train the models on both.

goal.title: Maximize <acc>efficiency</acc> — by swapping layers until we find the perfect paradigm combination.
goal.lead: The objective is to maximize the efficiency of a language model along four axes — cost, quality, time, and energy consumption — by swapping out each layer to find the perfect paradigm combination.

ourTeam.title: The people behind QPT.
ourTeam.lead: A team of engineers and researchers uniting quantum, photonic and thermodynamic computing into one machine.
